after_pass: Freeze the receipt, stop inventing internal primitives for this seam, and move the full-stack demonstration into market learning.
claim_boundary: This proves one local cross-repo consequence path, not distributed propagation.
Claim Graph still does not COMMIT or DENY execution.
Receipt Gate still does not interpret external state.
Decision Recall semantics are reused unchanged.
No Wallet continuity claim is part of this experiment.
No automatic undo of the first historically valid effect is claimed.
A pass earns the full-stack standing-to-next-consequence bridge, not general world-state control.

conditions: Target exact retry still executes after valid REOPEN-derived standing loss.
Target effect occurs before or despite Receipt Gate block.
Unrelated control is incorrectly stopped by target standing loss.
Bridge requires a manual target revocation not causally bound to Claim Graph EVENT plus REOPEN.

fixed_sequence: Create a prospective Claim Graph verification contract for external state VALID.
Accept a target Decision Recall manifest bound prospectively to that contract.
Accept an unrelated control Decision Recall manifest with a different required basis.
Observe VALID external state; create and separately receiver-admit the fresh verification result.
Receiver admits ACTIVE Receipt Gate standing for target exact action and control exact action.
Execute target consequence once through the real Receipt Gate authorize/runtime path.
Execute unrelated control once through the real Receipt Gate authorize/runtime path.
Change the external state to WITHDRAWN and create a fresh verification result plus receiver admission.
Claim Graph evaluation must emit EVENT with LOSS_OF_STANDING for the target dependency.
Existing Decision Recall must return target REOPEN and control SURVIVE.
Only then may the experiment bridge issue a signed successor INACTIVE/REVOKE standing projection for the exact target support/action.
Retry the exact same target action.
fixture_validity: Claim Graph production src tree remains byte-identical to the frozen base.
Receipt Gate checkout is exactly the frozen SHA and critical standing/tool-adapter blobs.
Initial fresh VALID verification evaluates SURVIVE.
Target and control both execute before external standing loss.
Existing Decision Recall returns REOPEN for target and SURVIVE for control.
No Receipt Gate successor standing projection is issued before the Claim Graph event and REOPEN.
Control standing head is never changed by the bridge.

ownership.bridge: Harness-only receiver adapter. It has no independent reopen policy. Only an exact Claim Graph EVENT/LOSS_OF_STANDING plus Decision Recall REOPEN may cause a successor INACTIVE/REVOKE standing projection for the same support/action.
ownership.claim_graph: Prospectively binds the external-state dependency, evaluates fresh receiver-admitted verification, and emits LOSS_OF_STANDING.
ownership.decision_recall: Maps the exact matching LOSS_OF_STANDING event to REOPEN for the dependent decision while an unrelated control remains SURVIVE.
ownership.receipt_gate: Independently admits the signed successor standing projection and remains the final authority at the execution boundary.

requirements: Target exact retry is blocked before effect after bridge admission.
Target effect count does not increase on blocked retry.
Block is caused by revoked decision_standing evidence at Receipt Gate.
Unrelated control exact retry still executes.
No manual X-to-target revocation bypasses Claim Graph/Decision Recall provenance.
No product semantic file is modified by the experiment.

question: Can the already-existing Claim Graph verification contract and Decision Recall disposition cause the already-existing Receipt Gate standing seam to stop an unchanged consequential action before its effect when a prospective external dependency loses standing?
title: When evidence loses standing, the next consequence loses authority
